messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Tirzepatide carries a Boxed Warning for the risk of possible thyroid tumors.
Possible Thyroid Tumors (Including Cancer):
Tell your healthcare provider if you get a lump or swelling in your neck, hoarseness, trouble swallowing, or shortness of breath.
These may be symptoms of thyroid cancer.
In studies with rats, tirzepatide and medicines that work like tirzepatide have caused thyroid tumors.
These tumors include thyroid cancer.
It is not known if tirzepatide will cause thyroid tumors.
It is not known if tirzepatide will cause medullary thyroid carcinoma.
Medullary thyroid carcinoma is a type of thyroid cancer.
This applies to people.
Do not use tirzepatide if you or any of your family have ever had a type of thyroid cancer called medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC).
Do not use tirzepatide if you have an endocrine system condition called Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2).
Triplet: ["Tirzepatide", "has unknown effect", "medullary thyroid carcinoma"]

The relation 'has unknown effect' in the triplet is defined as 'It is not known whether the subject drug will cause the effect specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has unknown effect on': The effect of the subject drug on the entity specified by the object entity is not known.
B. 'not same as': The subject drug's effect is not the same as the event or condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'has no interaction with': The subject drug does not have a known pharmacological interaction with the object entity.
D. 'does not act on': The subject drug does not exert its effects directly on the anatomical or physiological entity specified by the object entity.
E. 'not expected to affect': The subject substance is not anticipated to have an effect on the specified object entity.
F. None of the above.
